candidate_signal: absolute baseline Bottom story shear only
candidate_definition: saved-grid local absolute maxima, plateau first point, endpoints one-sided, value >= (1-epsilon)*baseline absolute maximum
event_cluster: none: retain all local maxima; do not merge nearby candidates using actual response
evaluation: at frozen baseline candidate times read actual absolute response; compare its maximum with complete actual peak; retain signed values/time/source rows
neighborhood_scope: secondary practical diagnostic around baseline candidates, not guarantee or independent prediction
report: candidate counts, exact saved-grid capture, practical peak error <=1%, actual peak-time proximity <=0.10s, baseline value at actual control time, misses
scope: post-analysis checking and prioritization; actual-scheme histories remain needed; no guaranteed screening from 5% threshold
